**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).** Status is ONGOING, not resolved.

Root cause: `dep-4471` set `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true`. The gateway opens a connection per request against a pool of `size 20`. Result is 530 `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED` errors and `connection churn: 4180 opens in the last 5m, baseline is 40`.

Window: `02:14:18.972Z` to log end `03:59:27.974Z`, 1h 45m, 83% error rate. All five `/v1/*` endpoints down. Only `/health` returns 200, so it is a false all-clear.

Next: roll back `dep-4471` and set `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false`.
